test_get_distribution: test the get_distribution function to retrieve a named distribution by key and verify it returns description and toolsets
test_list_distributions: test the list_distributions function returns a copy of all available distributions without mutating the original
test_validate_distribution: test the validate_distribution function returns true for valid distribution names and false for unknown or empty strings
test_sample_toolsets_from_distribution: test the sample_toolsets_from_distribution function samples toolsets probabilistically from a named distribution
test_distribution_structure: test all DISTRIBUTIONS entries have required keys, valid probability ranges, and non-empty descriptions
